title: Segment Anything (SAM)
core_mech: 可缓存的重型 image encoder、轻量 prompt encoder 与双向 attention mask decoder 解耦，并以动态 hypernetwork 输出多候选 mask。
core_mech_en: Decouples a heavy cacheable ViT image encoder from a lightweight spatial prompt encoder (points/boxes/masks) and an ambiguity-aware two-way attention mask decoder.
input_desc: 图像与点、框、粗 mask 或文本映射后的空间提示
input_en: 2D image + interactive spatial prompts (foreground/background points, bounding box, or coarse mask)
output_desc: 多个候选二值 mask 及其质量分数
output_en: Multiple candidate binary segmentation masks with predicted IoU quality scores

adapter.name: Segment Anything (SAM)
adapter.mechanism: Original window/global ViT, Fourier point/box prompt encoder, two-way attention decoder, three ambiguity masks, IoU head, and error-guided correction with previous-mask prompts.
limitations: Unmodified Apache-2.0 author architecture at reduced image size/width/depth with random initialization; no MAE initialization, SA-1B pretraining, or zero-shot performance claim.

Teaching training uses an initial supplied foreground point and two prompt rounds by default. The 11-round mixed point/box schedule, noisy boxes, large-scale data engine and original optimizer schedule are not reproduced.

Mask supervision uses minimum-over-candidate 20× focal + Dice; IoU regression supervises every returned candidate. Default supplied synthetic prompts come from ground truth and are explicit inputs, not predicted detections.
